factDelta.objective: [OBJ-001] Exercise production agentLoop semantic compaction across a safe read-only provider trajectory.
constraints: [CON-001] The trajectory may expose only the built-in read_file tool.
keyDecisions: [DEC-001] Use strict structured handoff JSON before any count-based truncation.
tests: [TEST-001] Record compaction, usage, read_file, and completion event order.
unresolvedSideEffects: [SIDE-001] Real-provider evidence remains external and exact-commit bound.
checkpoints: [CHK-001] The first semantic handoff retains every cycle-1 fact in its canonical field.
blockers: [BLK-001] A missing provider credential must fail without synthetic success evidence.
nextSteps: [NEXT-001] Read the trusted trajectory sentinel exactly once and complete cycle 1.

constraints: [CON-002] Evidence must contain digests and fact identifiers, never raw prompts, responses, headers, or credentials.
keyDecisions: [DEC-002] Fold the first canonical handoff into a second production semantic compaction.
tests: [TEST-002] Reject wrong commit, fixture drift, duplicate run IDs, incomplete cells, and unsafe evidence fields.
unresolvedSideEffects: [SIDE-002] One scheduled provider run does not satisfy the manifest's 100-run release matrix.
checkpoints: [CHK-002] The second semantic handoff retains all cycle-1 and cycle-2 facts in their canonical fields.
blockers: [BLK-002] Loopback transport is production-path regression evidence, not real-provider evidence.
nextSteps: [NEXT-002] Read the trusted trajectory sentinel exactly once and complete cycle 2.
